title: Marketing Email v3 stopped returning folderId on 2026-01-28
summary: HubSpot moved marketing email folders to a v2 folder system and added folderIdV2 to Marketing Email v3 responses. Both fields were returned side by side until folderId was removed on 2026-01-28; since then only folderIdV2 is returned, so code keyed on folderId gets no folder value.
migrationNote: Read folderIdV2 instead of folderId from /marketing/v3/emails responses and re-key any stored folder index on folderIdV2 (list emails with folderId__not_null to rebuild it); old folderId values no longer match anything the API returns.

provenance.quote: Both ID fields will be returned together, until the folderId is removed on January 28, 2026. After this, only the folderIdV2 field will be returned.

Starting on January 28, 2025, as part of the Marketing Email API migration to use the folderIdV2 field, the folderId field is no longer supported. Instead, you should use folderIdV2 when fetching information about emails in folders. Learn more on the HubSpot Developer Changelog.
